user.title: Find an Entur stop place
user.description: Search by name. Results are stop places, such as stations, terminals, and transport hubs. Individual platforms are intentionally not shown in this step.

data_description.query: Enter at least two characters, for example Oslo S or Nationaltheatret.

select_stop.title: Select a stop place
select_stop.description: Choose the stop place that matches your location. The result includes locality and transport modes to help distinguish similarly named stops.

select_routes.title: Choose routes for this stop place
select_routes.description: Select one or more routes to show for this stop place. Leave the selection empty to show all routes.

confirm.title: Confirm the stop place

error.query_too_short: Enter at least two characters to search for a stop place.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to search Entur right now. Try again later.
error.no_results: No stop places were found. Try a broader search or another spelling.
error.invalid_selection: The selected stop place is no longer available. Start the search again.

abort.already_configured: This stop place is already configured.
abort.invalid_selection: The selected stop place could not be confirmed.
